source.name: OLBG — Snooker Betting Tips
source.method: HTTP GET of server-rendered HTML via urllib; no JavaScript execution
source.licence_note: Publicly viewable page. Factual market listing retained for review.

notes: OLBG tipster consensus counts are display-only and are never fed into snooker scoring.
OLBG does not expose structured odds in server-rendered HTML, so no price fields exist (IR-SNOOKER-01).
Tournament, round, venue and date are joined from the official WST/snooker.org records in the page/engine layer, never from OLBG alone.
